body:
Founder real-time: 3 swords + beginner/lvl7/lvl10 armor sets. Seeded through IDUNA's new /admin/gfd-items tool itself (dogfooding), live-verified loading correctly via the real itemdefReg.LoadFile. Found and flagged, not fixed: two existing items (Leather Gloves, Spiked Knuckles) use un-hyphenated equip_slots that never matched gear.AllSlots's real hand-l/hand-r values -- permanently unequippable as authored; new content uses correct slot names. ITEM_BUILDER_NORTHSTAR.md updated with a new Item Design Principles section recording real founder direction (FFXI job lists not WoW armor tiers, FlagRare/FlagEx already correctly separate tradability axes). Commit a829bd2.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD item content: 18 new items (3 swords, 3 armor sets) via new GUI
